details: Major transfer day — protect buffer time around station logistics.
Hotel shift: Keio Plaza Hotel Shinjuku → Cross Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi.
Shinjuku → Tokyo Station: JR Chuo Rapid Line from Shinjuku Station (~25 min, ¥220). Walk 5 min from Keio Plaza to Shinjuku Station south gates.

Luggage forwarding (takkyubin): request at hotel concierge the evening before. Yamato Transport delivers bags to Cross Hotel Kyoto by next afternoon (~¥1,500–2,000/bag). Travel hands-free on the train.
Mt Fuji is typically visible from the right side headed from Tokyo to Kyoto (Seat E side); verify actual reserved car/seat in SmartEX before departure.
If Cross Hotel check-in is delayed, store bags at the hotel or Kyoto Station lockers and keep Nishiki/Gion flexible.
Energy strategy: sightseeing light, ambiance heavy. Evening in Gion is the reward.
note: First intercity rail day. Keep schedule disciplined but calm.
